_meta.source_policy: A field is only filled when a first-party page (the Amazon product detail page for that ASIN, or the manufacturer's own documentation) states it. Conflicting first-party statements leave the field blank and raise a flag. Aggregator and 'review farm' sites are never used as sources.
_meta.price_policy: No price or availability is printed anywhere on this site. Amazon Associates Program Policies §2(b) permit showing price and availability only when Amazon serves the link containing that data, or when the data comes from the Creators API / PA API. _meta.rating_policy: Star rating and review counts are point-in-time observations stamped with observed_at. They are not live and must be re-read before publication.

products.title: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets
products.tagline: Two baskets, two windows, one finish time.
products.best_for: Cooking a main and a side at different temperatures without owning two appliances.

capacity_spec_table.note: The page's own spec table says 6 liters; the title and bullets say 6 quart (≈5.68 L). FLG-007.

wattage.note: Not stated on the product detail page. Third-party listings claim 1700 W; not first-party, so left blank.

model_number.note: Not stated on the product detail page.

tradeoffs: Six quarts is the combined figure — 3 quarts per basket. A single large item (a whole chicken, a wide pizza) will not fit the way it fits a single-chamber 8- or 10-quart basket.
Two drawers means two things to wash, not one.

products.title: Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt | TurboFry 4-in-1 with 450°F Hi-Fry Option, Bake, Dehydrate, Frozen, XL Nonstick Dishwasher-Safe Basket, Stainless Steel
products.tagline: One big square basket, four modes, honest cleanup.
products.best_for: Batch cooking for four to six people who want one large chamber and one thing to wash.

wattage.note: The Amazon bullet list says '1000 Watts/120 Volts – RJ38-SQSS-8T'; third-party listings for the same model say 1700 W. Unresolved, so left blank. FLG-005.

model_number.note: As printed in the Amazon bullet list.

window.note: This ASIN's variant does not state a window. A separate windowed variant (RJ38-SQSS-8TW) exists.

dishwasher_safe_basket.value: Yes — basket and flat frying tray, top rack

hi_fry.value: Yes — 450°F for the final two minutes

tradeoffs: One chamber means one temperature at a time. A crisp side and a slow main cannot run simultaneously.
The 400°F ceiling is lower than the 450°F Hi-Fry finish, which is a short final stage rather than a full cook temperature.

products.title: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven, Countertop Convection Cooker, Extra Large Interior, Six Cooking Accessories Included
products.tagline: An oven that happens to air fry.
products.best_for: Households that want one countertop box to replace a toaster oven and an air fryer basket.

capacity_total.note: Spec table states 24.6 liters. 26 US quarts ≈ 24.6 L, so these are the same volume in different units — but the page presents them as if they were two different numbers. FLG-004.

temperature_range.note: No temperature range is stated on the product detail page.

wattage.note: Not stated on the product detail page.

model_number.note: Not stated on the product detail page.

preset_count.note: Title says '24 One-Touch Preset Options', the bullet list says '25 COOKING PRE-SETS', the spec table says 24. FLG-004.

controls.value: One-touch presets, French doors, interior light

dishwasher_safe_basket.note: The page does not state dishwasher suitability for the accessories.

auto_shutoff.value: Yes — oven turns off when the toast timer ends

rotisserie.value: Yes — stated capacity for a 6-lb chicken

tradeoffs: A toaster-oven footprint. At 16.9" deep it needs real counter depth, and it needs headroom above because it vents.
An oven cavity preheats and recovers more slowly than a basket air fryer for a single portion of fries.
Accessory count is high, which is a storage question as much as a cooking one.

products.title: ThermoMaven 1 Sec Professional Digital Meat Thermometer, ±0.5°F Accuracy, NIST & NSF Certified, Auto-Rotate Bright LED Screen, IP67 Waterproof
products.tagline: The cheap upgrade that fixes the guesswork.
products.best_for: Anyone who already owns an air fryer or oven and keeps overcooking protein.

certification.note: Recorded exactly as the page states it. We have not independently validated the certificates.

included.value: Thermometer, 1× AAA battery, user manual, calibration certificate

dimensions.note: No dimensions in the page's spec table.

tradeoffs: An instant-read gives you a number, not a narrative. You still have to know the target temperature for what you are cooking.
The page notes a newer colour variant exists; check which variant you are adding to the cart.

products.title: CHEF iQ Sense Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer, 3 Ultra-Thin Probes, WiFi Unlimited Range, 1000°F Heat Safe, 5 Sensors, Gen3
products.tagline: Set it, walk away, get told when it is done.
products.best_for: Long cooks — smoking, roasting, rotisserie — where you cannot stand at the oven.

connectivity.value: WiFi, described by the listing as unlimited range
connectivity.note: Range in practice depends on your own WiFi coverage, not the thermometer.

accuracy.note: This ASIN's page does not print a ± tolerance figure.

dimensions.note: No dimensions in the page's spec table.

tradeoffs: Wireless probes trade batteries and pairing for freedom of movement. If the app or WiFi drops, you are back to guessing.
The higher price only pays off if you actually cook long roasts. For a weeknight chicken breast, a cheap instant-read does the same job.

categories.label: Air fryers
categories.headline: Basket, dual-basket, or French-door oven
categories.blurb: Three very different shapes of appliance that all get called an air fryer. The right one depends on whether you cook two things at once, one big thing, or a whole tray.

categories.label: Meat thermometers
categories.headline: Instant-read versus wireless probe
categories.blurb: One tells you the number in two seconds. The other tells you the number from the other side of the house. They solve different problems and most kitchens want the first one.
